newsitem.title: MEXICO: TV Azteca to invest $200 mln for growth abroad.
newsitem.headline: TV Azteca to invest $200 mln for growth abroad.

text.p: Ricardo Salinas Pliego, president of TV Azteca, which went public on Friday, said the broadcaster would invest some $200 million over the next three years in expansion projects abroad.
"In the next three years we could invest around $200 million in the expansion of Television Azteca outside the country," Salinas told Reuters.
Salinas Pliego said he had plans to expand local stations, acquire more stations in Central and South America and boost the export of programming.
"We want to buy more stations in Central America, South America, so that they can use our programming," he said.
He said the broadcaster is creating a video library to sell programmes internationally, and some $50 million of Azteca's investments would go into the production of soap operas.
